svg.title: What runs where
svg.desc: Left, the Kubernetes cluster (locally Docker Desktop). In the namespace product-management: the gateway Deployment (2 to 6 pods, autoscaled at 70 percent CPU) behind the Service gateway on port 8080, a LoadBalancer locally and behind an Ingress with TLS in staging and production; a NetworkPolicy lets only the gateway reach the web Deployment (2 pods, Service web) and the api Deployment (2 to 8 pods, autoscaled at 60 percent), whose only Service is the headless Service api. The servers outside the cluster have no Service: the API's connection strings name them directly. The one Secret api-secrets holds the database password, the Redis password, the signing key and the consumers; the API's other settings are environment variables in its Deployment. In kube-system: metrics-server. In observability: Alloy, which reads every pod log and pushes it to Loki at LOKI_URL. Right, outside the cluster: the CI/CD pipeline, which runs the migrations with the API image as pm_migrator and then applies the overlay; the database server (PostgreSQL 18, users pm_app and pm_migrator); the cache server (Redis 8); the monitoring server (Loki and Grafana, optional); and the server agent that ships the servers' logs to Loki.
svg.text: stateless pods in the cluster; data and monitoring on their own servers
